evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Bretagne: Armorica, Britannia cismarina, Britannia minor, Letavia
terms.comment: Also Aremorica (M-O, after Ausonius). A country takes a preposition: in Armoricam (to), in Armoricā (in), ex Armoricā (from).

evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Britannia minor: Britannia minor, s. Armorica

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
